usedFor: Chartbrew holds dashboards, and “Create Project With Dashboard” and “Create Public Dashboard Link” set one up and share it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Team” in Chartbrew
bestTemplate.why: A message can set up a team in Chartbrew, with permissions ready for its projects.

watchOut: “Delete Project Permanently” removes a project for good, so check which project it names before it runs.
